name: class_union_optional_field_arm_stays_fallback
description: FALLBACK-BOUNDARY GUARD (family: union_class_optional_field). A class union arm with an OPTIONAL field: A{a int, b string?} | B{c int, d string} with {"a":1,"b":"x"}. BAML's Class::try_cast fills a MISSING optional with OptionalDefaultFromNoValue and SUCCEEDS at a non-zero score rather than not matching, which tryCastClass does not model (it fails the strict cast on any absent field). The collection-field broadening deliberately stops short of optional fields for exactly that reason, so this must keep DECLINING while BAML claims. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
